description: Works out one month's payslip for one employee in Malaysia: EPF, SOCSO, SKBBK, EIS and MTD (PCB) deductions, net pay, and the employer's contributions and total cost. Runs the same calculations as calculate_epf, calculate_socso_eis and calculate_mtd, feeding the employee EPF into MTD, and cites the source of every line. For a non_malaysian employee, say whether they are tax resident (taxResident). Fixed monthly salaries and standard reliefs only; no bonuses or zakat. Include the result's disclaimer in the answer to the user.

age.description: The employee's age in whole years.

children.description: Qualifying children at RM2,000 relief each: unmarried and under 18, or 18 and over in full-time education below diploma level. Must be 0 in category 1. Defaults to 0. Children in higher education or with a disability (which LHDN counts as 4 or 8) are not supported.

citizenship.description: malaysian, permanent_resident, or non_malaysian (a foreign worker without PR).

eisPayableBefore57.description: Required for employees aged 57 to 59: true if EIS contributions were payable for them before they turned 57 (even if never paid). Can't be worked out from age.

monthlySalary.description: Monthly salary in RM, at most 2 decimal places: basic pay plus fixed allowances. Excludes overtime, commission, bonuses and arrears.

payPeriod.description: The calendar month the salary is paid for, as YYYY-MM. It decides which rate tables apply. Defaults to the current month in Malaysia.

registeredWithEpfBefore1Aug1998.description: Only for non_malaysian: true if the employee registered with EPF before 1 Aug 1998, which puts them on the Malaysian rates. Defaults to false.

skbbkStatus.description: SOCSO's 24-hour protection scheme (SKBBK, Lindung 24 Jam). Everyone is covered by default; opted_out only if PERKESO approved the employee's opt-out, which foreign workers can't do. Defaults to covered.

taxCategory.description: Required for a tax resident. LHDN tax category. 1: single. 2: married and the spouse has no income (or is jointly assessed). 3: married with a working spouse, or divorced, widowed, or single with an adopted child.

taxResident.description: Required for a non_malaysian employee; defaults to true otherwise. true if tax resident in Malaysia (usually 182 days or more in the calendar year). false for the flat 30% non-resident MTD, with no reliefs: taxCategory, children, tp1Reliefs and yearToDate are then ignored.

tp1Reliefs.description: Other reliefs the employee claimed through payroll this month on form TP1 (LP1), in RM. Defaults to 0.

epf.description: The employee's EPF contributions in earlier months this year, in RM.

mtd.description: MTD deducted in earlier months this year, in RM.

remuneration.description: Gross monthly salary paid in earlier months this year, in RM.

tp1Reliefs.description: TP1 reliefs claimed in earlier months this year, in RM. Defaults to 0.

yearToDate.description: Required from February. Totals from earlier months of the same calendar year, including any previous employer's (all 0 for someone with no earlier income this year). Or "same_salary_all_year" if every earlier month had this salary and EPF, no TP1 reliefs, and its MTD deducted.

name: calculate_net_pay

basis.description: The rules each calculation used. Call calculate_epf, calculate_socso_eis or calculate_mtd for the full working.

deductions.description: What comes off the employee's pay.

employerContributions.description: What the employer pays on top of the salary.

employerCost.description: RM, monthly salary plus the employer's contributions

netPay.description: RM, monthly salary minus every statutory deduction

title: Calculate net pay (payslip)
